```{r setup}
library(targets)
source("R/facility-table.R")
```

```{r build-data}
#| cache: true
facility_tbl <- build_facility_table_data(
  expanded_map_geocoded  = tar_read(expanded_map_geocoded),
  expanded_map_presence  = tar_read(expanded_map_presence),
  expanded_map_panel     = tar_read(expanded_map_panel),
  ddp_raw                = tar_read(ddp_raw),
  detloc_lookup_complete = tar_read(detloc_lookup_complete),
  ddp_sparkline_src      = tar_read(ddp_new)
)
```

```{r table}
make_facility_table(
  facility_tbl,
  columns = c("facility", "type", "status", "adp", "ddp_peak",
              "detloc", "adp_bars", "ddp_sparkline")
)
```
